questions.subject: Chemistry
options: Alkali and Alkaline earth metals cannot be produced by chemical reduction methods.
$\mathrm{LiF}$ and $\mathrm{Li}_3 \mathrm{ N}$ are thermally stable compounds.
n the vapour phase $\mathrm{BeCl}_2$ has a polymeric chain structure consisting of numerous $\mathrm{BeCl}_2$ units.

When equimolar aqueous solutions of $\mathrm{SrCl}_2, \mathrm{MgCl}_2$ and $\mathrm{BaCl}_2$ are taken and their $\mathrm{pH}$ is recorded, $\mathrm{BaCl}_2$ solution recorded the highest $\mathrm{pH}$.
questions.solution:
Alkali and alkaline earth metals have very high negative standard electrode potentials, making them strong reducing agents. Therefore, they cannot be reduced by common chemical reducing agents like carbon or hydrogen, so the statement in (hIfp2) is correct.

Lithium has a high lattice energy due to the small size of the $\text{Li}^{+}$ ion. $\text{LiF}$ has a very high lattice energy, and $\text{Li}_{3}\text{N}$ is stable due to the high charge density of the nitride ion, making both thermally stable. Thus, (YPHJq) is correct.

In the vapour phase, $\text{BeCl}_{2}$ exists as a monomer or a dimer, not a polymeric chain. The polymeric chain structure is characteristic of the solid state. Therefore, the statement in (IiFKW) is incorrect.

The salts $\text{SrCl}_{2}$, $\text{MgCl}_{2}$, and $\text{BaCl}_{2}$ are salts of strong acids and strong bases, but they undergo slight hydrolysis depending on the polarizing power of the cation. $\text{Mg}^{2+}$ has the highest polarizing power, leading to more acidic character (lower pH), while $\text{Ba}^{2+}$ has the lowest polarizing power, resulting in a solution closest to neutral (highest pH). Thus, (C28mo) is correct.

Answer: n the vapour phase $\mathrm{BeCl}_2$ has a polymeric chain structure consisting of numerous $\mathrm{BeCl}_2$ units.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Among the alkali metals caesium is the most reactive because
options: its incomplete shell is nearest to the nucleus
it has a single electron in the valence shell
it is the heaviest alkali metal
the outermost electron is more loosely bound than the outermost electron of the other alkali metals.
questions.solution: Among the alkali metals, caesium is most reactive because the outermost electron is more loosely bound than the outermost electron of other alkali metals.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: During the fusion of an organic compound with sodium metal, nitrogen of the compound is converted into
questions.solution:
When a nitrogeneous organic compound is fused with sodium, the nitrogen present in the compound is converted into sodium cyanide.
This reaction is also called Lassaigne's test.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which metal has a greater tendency to form metal oxide?
questions.solution: Greater the stability of oxide, greater is the chance of its formation. Generally, ionic oxide are more stable, than covalent oxides and among the given metals only Ca form ionic oxide. Hence, Ca has grealer tendency to form oxide.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The main product obtained when a solution of sodium carbonate reacts with mercuric chloride is
questions.solution:
The main product obtained when sodium carbonate reacts with mercuric chloride is mercuric oxide.
$\mathrm{HgCl}_{2}+\mathrm{Na}_{2} \mathrm{CO}_{3} \longrightarrow \mathrm{HgO}+\mathrm{CO}_{2}+2 \mathrm{NaCl} or \mathrm{HgCO}_{3}+2 \mathrm{NaCl}$

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Sodium dissolves in liquid $\mathrm{NH}_{3}$ to give a deep blue solution. This is due to
questions.solution: $\mathrm{Na}+(x+y) \mathrm{NH}_{3} \longrightarrow\left[\mathrm{Na}\left(\mathrm{NH}_{3}\right)_{x}\right]^{+}+\left[e\left(\mathrm{NH}_{3}\right)_{y}\right]^{-}$. The deep blue colour of the solution is due to the ammoniated electron which absorbs energy in the visible region of light and thus, imparts blue colour to the solution.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
Railway wagon axles are made by heating iron rods embedded in charcoal powder.
This process is known as
questions.solution: The process of hardening of iron rods of railway wagon axles embedded in charcoal powder is known as case-hardening. In this process surface of iron rods get hardened by depositing a layer of steel on its surface.
